left.title: GitHub launches Copilot code review APIs
left.excerpt: GitHub released Copilot code review through REST and GraphQL APIs for existing subscribers. The rollout adds programmatic review requests.

right.title: GitHub 推出 Copilot 代码审查 API
right.excerpt: GitHub 发布了面向现有订阅者的 Copilot 代码审查 REST 和 GraphQL API，开发者现在可以通过程序提交审查请求。

left.title: Atlas opens its code assistant to enterprise users
left.excerpt: Atlas announced that its code assistant is now generally available to enterprise subscribers. The release includes repository search and automated pull request summaries.

right.title: Enterprise launch for the Atlas code assistant
right.excerpt: Enterprise subscribers can now use Atlas's generally available code assistant, with repository search and automatic summaries of pull requests.

left.title: Orion v2 launches with offline code search
left.excerpt: Orion v2 was released with an offline code search feature for local repositories. The release also adds support for the Rust language.

right.title: Orion v3 launches with offline code search
right.excerpt: Orion v3 was released with an offline code search feature for local repositories. The release also adds support for the Go language.

left.title: Nimbus announces its new developer plan
left.excerpt: Nimbus announced a new developer plan priced at $20 per month. The company says this is the final price at launch and includes unlimited repository indexing.

right.title: Nimbus developer plan launches
right.excerpt: Nimbus announced a new developer plan priced at $40 per month. The company says this is the final price at launch and includes unlimited repository indexing.

left.title: Vertex releases an automated review agent
left.excerpt: Vertex released an automated code review agent for enterprise subscribers. The release supports local repositories and flags potential security defects.

right.title: Independent testing of Vertex's new review agent
right.excerpt: Vertex released an automated code review agent for enterprise subscribers. An independent test on 200 pull requests found that the agent missed 18 security defects and frequently produced false alarms.

left.title: New harbor opens for cargo shipping
left.excerpt: A new harbor has opened for international cargo ships. The port authority says the facility includes refrigerated storage and dedicated rail connections.

right.title: Pioneer adds code search to its editor
right.excerpt: Pioneer announced a code search feature in its editor. Developers can use the new feature to locate functions and navigate existing source repositories.

left.title: Forge clarifies its data retention policy
left.excerpt: Forge says its new coding assistant stores customer source code on its servers and uses that code for model training. This policy applies to every enterprise account.

right.title: Forge explains source code handling
right.excerpt: Forge says its new coding assistant does not store customer source code on its servers and does not use that code for model training. This policy applies to every enterprise account.
